title: 第0013章 血战深山药力焚天第0014章 仙茅破障残脉初通
content_zh:
------
淬体境后期护卫队长那一撞，可谓是惊天动地。
他庞大的身躯将山壁撞出一个浅坑，碎石簌簌落下，一口鲜血更是喷出了三尺远，脸色瞬间煞白如纸。他握刀的手虎口崩裂，鲜血直流，看向林药尘的眼神充满了难以置信的惊骇。
“你……你怎么可能这么强？！”
一个昔日里的废柴，一个连淬体境门槛都摸不到的绝脉之人，竟然一拳轰飞了他这个淬体境后期？！
这简直颠覆了他的认知！
林药尘站在原地，微微喘息。刚才那一拳，几乎抽干了他体内三成药力，双臂也在高频震颤，传来一阵酸麻。
“药徒二重，加上《药尊炮拳》的爆发，确实能越级挑战。但这具身体终究还是太弱了，单纯依靠药力支撑，持久力不足。”
电光火石之间，林药尘便分析清楚了自身的优劣。他不能给这两个护卫喘息和合围的机会，必须速战速决！
“杀了这小子！给队长报仇！”
另外两名淬体境中期的护卫此刻也红了眼，怒吼着冲了上来。一人持刀，横扫林药尘的下盘；另一人则弃刀，从腰间抽出一条带着倒钩的软鞭，直取林药尘的面门！
刀风凌厉，鞭影重重！
林药尘眼神一凛，脚下步伐变幻，竟是以一种极为诡异的步法向后滑行，堪堪避开了扫来的大刀。同时，他身体后仰，几乎与地面平行，那带着倒钩的软鞭贴着他的鼻尖呼啸而过！
“好险！”林药尘心中一惊。这两人配合默契，显然经常一起执行任务，远非之前那两个奴仆可比。
“仙鹤草，固本！白鲜皮，净神！”
林药尘心念一动，体内两股药力瞬间分流。仙鹤草的药力游走全身，稳住因刚才爆发而产生的气血翻涌；白鲜皮的药力则直冲眉心，让他的大脑瞬间清明，对方的招式轨迹在他眼中仿佛慢了下来。
“砰！”
林药尘单手撑地，借力一个鲤鱼翻身，稳稳落地。不等两人再次进攻，他主动发起了冲锋！
他选择了那个持刀的护卫作为突破口。
“药尊炮拳，崩岩！”

这一拳，不再是单纯的直来直往，而是在击中目标的瞬间，林药尘手腕巧妙一拧，拳力由刚转柔，再由柔化刚，产生了一股恐怖的螺旋劲力！
“噗嗤！”
持刀护卫的刀还没来得及收回，就被这股螺旋劲力击中了手腕。
“咔嚓！”
骨头断裂的声音清晰可闻！
“啊——！”护卫惨叫一声，大刀脱手飞出。
林药尘毫不停留，一脚侧踢，狠狠踹在对方的太阳穴上。
“咔嚓！”
又是一声脆响，护卫的惨叫声戛然而止，双眼一翻，直挺挺地倒了下去，生死不知。
秒杀一人！
剩下的那个使软鞭的护卫见状，吓得魂飞魄散，哪里还敢恋战，转身就跑。
content_en:
------
The collision with the guard captain at the late stage of the Body Tempering Realm was truly earth-shattering.
His huge body knocked a shallow crater out of the mountain wall, gravel fell, and a mouthful of blood spurted out three feet away, and his face instantly turned as white as paper. The hand holding the knife was cracked and bleeding, and the eyes he looked at Lin Yaochen were filled with unbelievable horror.
"You...how can you be so strong?!"
A good-for-nothing in the past, a person with an unparalleled pulse who couldn't even touch the threshold of the Body Tempering Realm, actually knocked him away at a late stage of the Body Tempering Realm with one punch? !
This simply subverted his cognition!
Lin Yaochen stood there, panting slightly. The punch just now drained almost 30% of the medicine from his body, and his arms were trembling at high frequency, and there was a sense of soreness and numbness.
"The second level of Medicine Disciple, coupled with the explosion of "Yao Zun Cannon Fist", can indeed surpass the challenge. But this body is still too weak after all. It only relies on the power of medicine to support it, and its endurance is insufficient."
In the blink of an eye, Lin Yaochen analyzed his own strengths and weaknesses. He couldn't give the two guards a chance to breathe and encircle them, he had to fight quickly!
"Kill this kid! Revenge the captain!"
The other two guards in the middle stage of the body quenching realm also had red eyes at this moment and rushed forward with roars. One person held a knife and swept across Lin Yaochen's lower body; the other person abandoned the knife, pulled out a soft whip with a barb from his waist, and struck Lin Yaochen directly in the face!
The sword wind is fierce and the whip shadow is heavy!
Lin Yaochen's eyes flashed, and his steps changed. He actually slid backwards with an extremely weird footwork, barely avoiding the sweeping sword. At the same time, he leaned back, almost parallel to the ground, and the soft whip with a barb whizzed past the tip of his nose!
"What a risk!" Lin Yaochen was shocked. The two of them cooperated tacitly and obviously often performed tasks together, far beyond the comparison of the two slaves before.
"Agrimonium strengthens the root! The fresh white skin purifies the spirit!"
With a thought in Lin Yaochen's mind, the two medicinal powers in his body were instantly diverted. The medicinal power of agrimony spread throughout the body, stabilizing the surge of energy and blood caused by the previous explosion; the medicinal power of white fresh skin went straight to the center of his eyebrows, making his brain instantly clear, and the trajectory of the opponent's moves seemed to slow down in his eyes.
"Bang!"
Lin Yaochen supported the ground with one hand, used the force to turn over like a carp, and landed firmly on the ground. Before the two of them could attack again, he took the initiative to charge!
He chose the knife-wielding guard as his breakthrough point.
"Yao Zun Cannon Fist, Rock Collapse!"
This punch was no longer simply a straight punch, but at the moment it hit the target, Lin Yaochen cleverly twisted his wrist, and the force of the punch changed from hard to soft, and then from soft to hard, creating a terrifying spiral force!
"Pfft!"
Before the sword guard could retract his sword, he was hit on the wrist by this spiral force.
"Crack!"
The sound of bones breaking is clearly audible!
"Ah——!" the guard screamed, and the sword flew out.
Lin Yaochen didn't stop and kicked the opponent hard on the temple.
"Crack!"
There was another crisp sound, and the guard's screams suddenly stopped. His eyes rolled up, and he fell straight down, not knowing whether he was alive or dead.
Kill one person instantly!
When the remaining guard who used the soft whip saw this, he was so frightened that he didn't dare to fight, so he turned around and ran away.
